title: Long exact minimization of independently verified obstruction certificates
research_question: How far can each independently verified canonical obstruction certificate be reduced by exact rational re-solving and repeated deletion of support variables and certificate terms?
minimality_method: time-bounded randomized greedy deletion with exact rational Gaussian re-solving; all retained identities are independently reverified; global minimality is not claimed
scientific_output: A compact exact library of reduced support-restricted obstruction certificates for GPT-5.6 Sol to inspect and generalize.
next_decision: Manually review the minimized library before deciding whether to construct deletion contrasts.
